title: CHINESEVIDEOBENCH: BENCHMARKING MULTI-MODAL LARGE MODELS FOR CHINESE VIDEO QUESTION ANSWERING

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on a newly curated Chinese video question-answering dataset to reveal performance deficits stemming from overwhelmingly English-centric training data and evaluation frameworks.

Assessing models on their understanding of Chinese-specific cultural references, idioms, and context-specific knowledge through human-annotated, culturally relevant video QA tasks (e.g., Chinese World Knowledge).
